## Professional Summary

Muhammad Haris Awan is a Full-Stack AI Engineer based in Karachi, Pakistan, specializing in building award-winning multi-agent AI systems in production. His core expertise spans multi-agent orchestration, self-correcting agent loops, RAG pipelines, autonomous code generation, intelligent decision-making systems, and real-time SSE streaming architectures using Next.js, FastAPI, Google ADK, and OpenAI Agent SDK.

He is the Track Winner (Urdu & Regional Language Tech) at Pakistan's largest-ever AI hackathon—the Alibaba Cloud AI Hackathon Pakistan 2026—earning $2,000 + 1,000 Alibaba Cloud credits for Mashwara AI, with media coverage and recognition from Bano Qabil and Alkhidmat Foundation. He also achieved Silver Tier Winner in Google AI Seekho 2026 with Morph OS. He is actively advancing his expertise in the Governor Initiative for Artificial Intelligence Course (GIAIC) while spearheading client products and AI workflows at WEBXES LLC.

## Key Projects

### Mashwara AI — Multilingual Executive Decision Platform
🏆 **Track Winner at Alibaba Cloud AI Hackathon Pakistan 2026 ($2,000 + 1,000 Alibaba Cloud credits)**
A multilingual agentic decision-support platform designed for Pakistan. Simulates a virtual council of 6 specialized AI agents running in parallel via Google ADK to debate, critique, and produce structured, voted executive consultations. Includes a custom MCP web-search tool for live market intelligence, file attachment support, STT, and TTS.
- **URL:** https://mashwara-ai.vercel.app/
- **Tech:** Google ADK, Agentic AI, FastAPI, React, Next.js, MCP

### Morph OS — Generative AI Workspace
🥈 **Silver Tier Winner at Google AI Seekho 2026**
A generative operating system that routes natural language into interactive React applications in under 2 seconds via a 34-template cache layer. Features a 6-agent pipeline (Brain planner, Builder, Editor, Critic-Fixer, Chat, Search) with a self-correcting Critic-Fixer loop that verifies and auto-repairs generated code, thread-safe SSE streaming, JWT/OAuth auth, and pgvector semantic search on Neon. Deployed as an installable PWA.
- **URL:** https://morph-os-haris.vercel.app/
- **Demo Video:** https://youtu.be/rCgnH5MLSpk?si=a0-3OeZQIPoM9rlL
- **Tech:** Agentic AI, Gemini SDK, FastAPI, React, Next.js, pgvector, PWA

### Karachi Run — 3D Endless Runner
A mobile-first, browser-based 3D endless runner inspired by the sights of Karachi. Sprint through a stylized city, weave between buses and rickshaws, ride rooftop ramps, collect coins, and follow an iconic route from Saddar to Sea View.
- **URL:** https://karachi-run.vercel.app/
- **Tech:** Babylon.js, WebGL, Vite, Neon Postgres

### WEBXES LLC — US-Based Web Agency Platform
A modern web design & development partner that builds scalable websites, ecommerce platforms, and apps. Designed and engineered webxes.com, achieving Lighthouse scores of 98 Performance, 95 Accessibility, 100 Best Practices, and 100 SEO.
- **URL:** https://www.webxes.com/
- **Tech:** Next.js, React, Tailwind CSS

### DoneKaro — AI Powered Todo App
An AI-powered full-stack task management application with an integrated AI chatbot assistant. Available as both a responsive web app and an Android app built with Capacitor.
- **URL:** https://q4-todo-hackathon.vercel.app/
- **Demo Video:** https://youtu.be/9hVFsnVX6pM?si=KGwXyD4wMfCfBkvo
- **Tech:** Next.js, FastAPI, PostgreSQL (Neon), Capacitor

### Physical AI & Humanoid Robotics — Capstone Book
A comprehensive guide for engineering students and professionals in humanoid robotics, physical AI, and robot learning, built with Docusaurus and featuring a RAG Chatbot powered by FastAPI, Google Gemini, Neon Postgres, and Qdrant Cloud.
- **URL:** https://q4-book-hackathon-1.vercel.app/
- **Demo Video:** https://youtu.be/f7M5I0qJ5A4?si=Lv-w6Kx48bHjmetN
- **Tech:** Docusaurus, FastAPI, Google Gemini, Qdrant Cloud, Neon Postgres
